meta.title: Mountain & Rope Rescue Training Facilities
meta.description: TZJ mountain and rope rescue training facilities — cliff, elevation, and shaft terrain replication with multi-anchor, multi-path design for rope skills, high-angle transfer, litter rescue, and team coordination.

hero.title: Mountain & Rope Rescue Training Facilities
hero.description: For mountain and high-angle rescue teams: Can you rig systems fast on cliff faces? Is litter transfer drilled to standard? Can shaft rescue run as a coordinated team? A controllable, repeatable, multi-path rope training ground lets complex terrain play out in training first.

overview.title: Rescue capability in complex terrain
overview.description: Mountain and high-angle rescue leaves no room for error. Only repeated training in terrain close to reality builds instinctive rope skills and team coordination.
overview.lead: Multi-path, multi-anchor, multi-elevation design supporting a complete training system from individual technique to team coordination.
overview.body: Belay stations and fall-protection redundancy enable high-intensity training of high-risk disciplines within safe boundaries.

featuresSection.title: Six capabilities of rope rescue facilities
featuresSection.description: Built on cliff, elevation, and shaft terrain — covering the full rescue workflow from rope skills to litter transfer.

features.title: Complex Terrain Replication
features.desc: Simulates cliffs, steep slopes, elevation changes, and shafts — close to real mountain rescue environments.

features.title: Vertical Lift & Transfer
features.desc: Systematic training for descent, ascent, traverse, and haul rope techniques.

features.title: Diverse Anchor Systems
features.desc: Pre-installed reliable anchors and deviation points for anchor building and system rigging training.

features.title: Litter Rescue
features.desc: Supports vertical and diagonal litter transfer, casualty packaging, and escort disciplines.

features.title: Multi-Path Design
features.desc: Multiple ascent/descent paths supporting team coordination and complex rescue drills.

features.title: Safety Assurance
features.desc: Belay stations, fall-protection systems, and safety redundancy for high-risk disciplines.
